nodes.label: VP-JEPA Architecture Specification v7
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth superseding v6; Training Paradigm v2 governs on conflict (v2 §0.5).

nodes.label: Shared Training Paradigm & Baseline Specification v2
Two-stage anticipation cascade (vision for leading legs, proprio latent for trailing legs)
nodes.rationale: Matches tripod gait physics: front legs see footholds; trailing legs cannot, so proprioceptive latent from front-leg contact propagates.

nodes.label: CPG clock (command-referenced, 0.8 Hz floor)
nodes.rationale: Stage-1 scaffolding; referenced to v_cmd so it is deployable and does not collapse on stall; removed with CPG rewards on one schedule because a visible clock biases policy toward tracking phase instead of anticipating.

nodes.label: Paired clock/CPG-reward anneal (first ~30% of Stage 2)
nodes.rationale: Annealing reward alone leaves clock in observation; input-dropout 0->100% on the same window avoids a sudden observation-space change.

nodes.label: Per-env phase reset jitter
nodes.rationale: Prevents overfitting a phase-to-terrain-onset correlation that would contaminate the lead-time metric.

nodes.label: CPG reward floors in Stage 2
nodes.rationale: cpg_z_target penalises exactly the deviations anticipation should produce; floors (not zero) prevent low-clearance shuffling.

nodes.label: cpg_force_target_penalty
nodes.rationale: Retained at moderate weight: impact-force shaping is aligned with anticipation (peak GRF is second headline metric) and kinder to actuators.

nodes.label: cpg_coxa velocity/contact reward terms
nodes.rationale: Contradictory signs on same joint/phase; abs(joint_vel) is a hacking vector - use signed, clipped velocity.

nodes.label: Toe point transform toe_pos_w
nodes.rationale: Tibia origin + 0.0892 constant is exact only at rest; toe height varies ~16 mm at 10 deg tibia pitch.

nodes.label: duty_factor single source
nodes.rationale: Six terms each held a copy; silent disagreement would give an incoherent gait target.

nodes.label: net_forces_w world-Z vs surface normal defect
D435 minimum-depth cutoff (Z_min)
nodes.rationale: Cutoff binds only when Z_min > h; at 848x480 Z_min ~0.175 m so mount h >= 0.20 m makes it inactive - no D405 needed.

nodes.label: Camera mount h ~0.22 m, pitch 45-50 deg
Self-occlusion Tier 1 ray-vs-capsule test
nodes.rationale: Microseconds on CPU; gives occlusion-aware masking without rendering.

nodes.label: Rolling-shutter skew model on RGB
nodes.rationale: Systematic and motion-correlated; must be modelled not randomized, else sim RGB-depth correspondence is tighter than hardware.

nodes.label: Retrieval scoped to front legs (odometry stack deleted)
nodes.rationale: Rear footholds need 2.5-3.5 s drift-free pose - not achievable; no VIO.

nodes.label: Position tracking error q_cmd - q_meas
nodes.rationale: Cleaner load proxy than AX-12A Present Load; free since q_cmd is in software.

nodes.label: Dropped reads: ZOH fill + 18-bit validity mask
nodes.rationale: Extrapolation rejected (second difference of quantised signal); drops correlate with load so must be injected into TCN input in sim.

nodes.label: Velocity estimator V (residual v_kin + dv)
nodes.rationale: Residual form removes the no-slip kinematic shortcut by construction; dv becomes an explicit slip estimate.

nodes.label: V trust tests (slip-stratified error, IMU dropout, slip weighting)
Vision encoder E_v (CNN stem + transformer)
nodes.rationale: CNN over ViT: TensorRT optimizes convs better, Orin has no DLA, locality suits terrain texture.

nodes.label: Per-horizon remaining lead time rem_k
nodes.rationale: Single latent_age scalar is not commensurate with tokens of different horizons.

nodes.label: Separate privileged critic
nodes.rationale: No shared trunk: value loss would imprint privileged structure into actor representations; query actual touchdown to decouple from FAH.

nodes.label: Decoupled SSL FIFO transition buffer with episode masking
nodes.rationale: Inside a 24-step rollout only 4/24 samples have a 400 ms target; lengthening rollout would distort PPO.

nodes.label: lambda_priv schedule tied to modality introduction
nodes.rationale: v6 annealed it to 0 before RGB (the friction-carrying modality) arrived in Stage 3.

nodes.label: Actuator saturation vs claim / static torque envelope
nodes.rationale: CoM lowering is torque-expensive; stride shortening and stance extension become primary reported adaptations.

nodes.label: Terrain conditions: friction primary, compliance secondary
Matte low-friction primary test surface (PTFE/talc)
nodes.rationale: Keeps depth validity uncorrelated with friction so depth-only arm is a clean geometric lower bound.

nodes.label: Appearance factorisation / material library
nodes.rationale: Library must break 'shiny implies slippery'; height field sampled independently of friction so RGB becomes load-bearing.

nodes.label: Training stages 1-3
nodes.rationale: Stage 2 cannot learn visual physics (depth decoupled); Stage 3 is the main stage; path tracing deleted.

nodes.label: Deployment execution split (CPU control, GPU anticipation)
Dynamixel bus configuration (RDT 0, FTDI 1 ms, position-only)
Foot contact switches on all six legs
nodes.rationale: Instrumentation only; turns lead time from inferred to measured.

nodes.label: Deferred ablation A: proprioceptive receptive field
Deferred ablation B: raw history stack

hyperedges.label: 30 Hz anticipation path (E_v, FAH, sampling, P)
Total loss L = JEPA + inv + priv + fah + vel + vic + PPO
Systematic, motion-correlated sim2real effects that must be modelled not randomized
